title: The Hospital That Healed Patients by Giving Them Malaria
hook: A 1920s Austrian psychiatrist believed that inducing high fevers with malaria could cure schizophrenia — and hundreds of patients died.
why_this_can_go_viral: Shock value of a Nobel-winning doctor intentionally infecting patients with a deadly parasite triggers disbelief and shareability.

title: The FDA Approved This Painkiller — Then Patients Started Rotting
hook: A popular anti-inflammatory drug caused flesh-eating bacterial infections in healthy patients, but the FDA kept it on the market for years.
why_this_can_go_viral: Visual descriptions of rotting flesh combined with FDA approval create visceral horror and distrust.

title: The Government That Put Radioactive Water in Kids' Toothpaste
hook: In the 1940s, a U.S. company sold 'Radium Toothpaste' claiming it would prevent cavities — it was actually irradiating children's mouths.
why_this_can_go_viral: The cognitive dissonance of 'toothpaste = radiation' is instantly shareable and historically shocking.

title: The Hospital That Billed Insurance for Amputating Healthy Limbs
hook: A Detroit surgeon performed hundreds of unnecessary amputations on patients who walked in with minor injuries — all for profit.
why_this_can_go_viral: The idea of a doctor cutting off limbs for money triggers primal fear and outrage, driving shares.

title: The 'Miracle' Weight Loss Shot That Destroyed Women's Kidneys
hook: A clinic in Brazil gave women a 'fat-dissolving' injection that turned their kidneys into mush — and 12 countries approved it.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines vanity, horror, and government failure — a perfect viral cocktail for health-conscious audiences.

title: The Doctor Who Injected Children With Heroin — Called It Medicine
hook: A respected New York physician prescribed heroin to children for colds in the 1900s, believing it was safer than whiskey.
why_this_can_go_viral: The audacity of giving heroin to children feels both historically absurd and terrifyingly relevant to the opioid crisis.

title: The Government Sanitarium That Starved 5,000 Patients to Death
hook: A state-run mental hospital in Pennsylvania systematically underfed patients for decades, killing them slowly while collecting their family money.
why_this_can_go_viral: The systematic, bureaucratic nature of the killing creates a chilling narrative that demands to be shared.

title: The Pharmaceutical Giant That Sold Chemo Drugs That Were Mostly Water
hook: A major company diluted cancer medications below potency for a decade — patients thought they were being treated, but they were just getting hydrated.
why_this_can_go_viral: The betrayal of cancer patients by the system meant to save them is emotionally devastating and highly shareable.

title: The Hospital That Ran Clinical Trials on Patients Without Telling Them
hook: A New York hospital experimented on mentally disabled children by feeding them radioactive oatmeal — and called it 'breakfast.'
why_this_can_go_viral: The combination of vulnerable children and radioactive food creates an unforgettable, anger-inducing narrative.

title: The 'Cure' That Gave Patients Creutzfeldt-Jakob Disease
hook: A Brazilian doctor's 'miracle' injections for Parkinson's disease were made from contaminated human pituitary glands — transmitting a fatal brain disease.
why_this_can_go_viral: The concept of treatment causing a rare, gruesome brain disease is inherently terrifying and mysterious.

title: The Drug Company That Put Glass Shards in Children's Vaccines
hook: A vaccine manufacturer knowingly distributed vials contaminated with microscopic glass fragments that caused severe infections in infants.
why_this_can_go_viral: The image of glass cutting into babies triggers immediate parental outrage and a powerful share impulse.

title: The Government That Sprayed Citizens with DDT From Airplanes
hook: The U.S. government sprayed entire neighborhoods with DDT in the 1950s, directly onto children playing outside — claiming it was 'health protection.'
why_this_can_go_viral: The Orwellian imagery of government planes spraying poison on families creates a visceral, shareable shock.

title: The Clinic That Stole 500 Eggs From Women — and Sold Them to Science
hook: A fertility doctor secretly removed eggs from anesthetized women during routine surgeries and sold them to research labs without consent.
why_this_can_go_viral: The violation of bodily autonomy and the 'babies stolen' angle triggers deep ethical outrage and shares.

title: The Hospital That Quarantined a Healthy Woman for 40 Years
hook: A woman committed for a minor mental health issue was locked in a state hospital for four decades — long after she was cured — because staff forgot her.
why_this_can_go_viral: The Kafkaesque horror of being forgotten by the system resonates deeply and compels shares.

title: The Government That Put Infants in 'Baby Cages' for Fresh Air
hook: In the 1930s, American cities hung wire cages outside apartment windows and placed babies inside them — claiming it prevented tuberculosis.
why_this_can_go_viral: The absurd and terrifying image of babies in birdcages hanging from windows is visually unforgettable and highly shareable.

title: The Drug That Gave Patients Uncontrollable Gambling Addiction
hook: A popular Parkinson's medication rewired patients' brains so severely they lost their life savings to gambling — and the company knew for years.
why_this_can_go_viral: The bizarre side effect of 'drug made me a gambler' is both fascinating and rage-inducing.

title: The Hospital That Left Surgical Tools Inside 1,000 Patients
hook: A hospital in Spain discovered that surgeons had accidentally left instruments, sponges, and clamps inside patients — over 1,000 cases in a decade.
why_this_can_go_viral: The sheer number of cases and the physical intimacy of 'found inside you' creates a visceral reaction.

title: The Doctor Who Infected Patients with Syphilis — On Purpose
hook: A Norwegian doctor injected syphilis into patients in the 1890s to study the disease's progression — and no one stopped him for 20 years.
why_this_can_go_viral: Purposefully infecting patients with a deadly STD is one of the darkest chapters in medical history.

title: The Government That Gave LSD to Unsuspecting Mental Patients
hook: A CIA-funded program gave acid to psychiatric patients without their knowledge for 15 years — and recorded their psychotic breaks for 'science.'
why_this_can_go_viral: The combination of government conspiracy, psychedelic drugs, and destroyed minds is a viral trifecta.
